deviations: OUT_OF_RANGE_ENTIRE: decision 5's origin union for tt extending beyond the knot range is replaced by the unbounded box (Interval::ENTIRE per axis). truck's der_n evaluates the basis recursion with the parameter left outside the knot range and extrapolates the boundary polynomial, so subs is unbounded as |t| -> inf; the origin union under-estimates and was replaced for soundness.

DEGENERATE_POINT_BOX: decision 5's literal 'lo >= hi -> empty hull' is applied only to lo > hi; lo == hi (e.g. [0.25, 0.25]) is hulled as the point subs(lo) with the hull widening, because the packet's own required test describes the degenerate point box as 'hull is the point'.

HULL_PAD_WIDENING: decision 4's single next_down/next_up per endpoint is replaced by a pad of 64*EPSILON*(1+|coord|) per endpoint. Boehm insertion and cut recompute control points in f64 and the two evaluation paths disagreed by up to ~10 ulps (measured on the packet's witnesses), so one ulp under-estimated.

DEGREE0_BOUNDARY_VALUES: hull_sub_curve additionally includes the source curve's subs(lo) and subs(hi). A degree-0 (piecewise-constant) hodograph's sub-curve evaluates at its right boundary hi with the left-limit piece, while the source curve's subs(hi) uses the right-open value from the piece past hi -- a different point that is still in the image over [lo, hi] (e.g. the uniform quadratic's der_2(0.75) = (16,24,16) escaped the raw sub-curve hull).
disagreements: Decision 5's stated reason for the origin union is false for this crate's evaluation path. The packet claims the Cox-de Boor basis functions are non-negative everywhere and sum to at most 1 outside the active domain; in fact truck's bspline_basis_functions for t outside [knot0, knotn] clamps the window and extrapolates (the clamped Bezier's own polynomial). Verified empirically: the quadratic t^2-t witness returns subs(-10) = (110, 0, 0) and subs(10) = (90, 0, 0), far outside hull(sub-curve) union origin. The origin union is therefore a silent wrong answer (BG-ENC-001) and the packet's required assert_encloses_curve boxes with negative lo, hi > 1 and [-10, 10] cannot pass under the literal design; the unbounded box is the sound replacement.

Decision 4's one-outward-ulp hull widening under-estimates: Boehm insertion and the two cuts accumulate f64 rounding that can push the source curve's evaluation several ulps outside the extracted sub-curve's control-point hull. Measured up to ~10 ulps on the packet's own witness set (e.g. enclose_der(1, [0.4, 0.6]) on the uniform quadratic missed der(0.4) by ~4 ulps of y before the HULL_PAD widening). The one-ulp discipline is only sound if the sub-curve construction is exact, which f64 Boehm insertion is not; the relative pad is the smallest sound correction found.
notes: EnclosureCurve for BSplineCurve<Point3> by the convex-hull property: sub_curve over [lo,hi] via Boehm add_knot to full multiplicity then Cut::cut twice (verified empirically that the extracted sub-curve reproduces the source curve, including the hodograph); hull of the sub-curve's control points padded outward; shared private hull_of used by enclose, enclose_der (n-fold hodograph via derivation()) and tangent_cone (ball-around-midpoint off the first hodograph's hull, guard in the packet's exact order !cn.is_finite() || !rho.is_finite() || cn <= rho, asin nudged by the house form and clamped to a named PI const). Generic over Point3/Vector3 via a local Coord trait because H-1 denies clippy::indexing_slicing and ControlPoint exposes coordinates only through Index. Witnesses: dyadic quadratic t^2-t (range [-1/4,0], hull [-1/2,0]), cubic t^3-t, helix-like 3D cubic, uniform quadratic straddling knots, a full-period loop whose derivative hull covers every direction, and an away-from-origin curve. 7 tests added: sampled-points soundness over all the packet's box families, out-of-range origin containment + inside exclusion, der_1..=3 partial match on interior and knot-straddling boxes, tangent-cone angle containment, cone refusal at t=1/2 and on the loop, strict tightness vs inari Horner on the two power-form witnesses, and 16-step bisection convergence (non-increasing up to HULL_PAD slack, final < initial/16). All 9 anchors match (1 each). fmt/clippy(-D warnings)/tests/workspace-check pass; the pre-existing 74 lib + 3 integration tests are unchanged and green.
